meta.title: Formula salary calc (per-country, no vendor)
meta.source: Computed from each country's published tax rates (tools/calc/*.py)
meta.note: Independent ground truth from published rates. Single filer, no personal deductions beyond the mandatory ones. Estimates for comparison.
